rules.label: Account age (months)
rules._comment: Red under 12 months, yellow from 12 to 23, green from 24 months.

rules.label: Connections
rules._comment: Red under 100, yellow from 100 to 200, green above 200. 500+ counts as 500.

rules.label: Verifications
rules._comment: Red when LinkedIn shows no verification. Many genuine members never verify.
